question: Pandit Bhajan Sopori, who died in the year 2022, was a famous player of which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is **Santoor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Bhajan Sopori** was a maestro of the **Santoor**, a stringed musical instrument.
 
• He hailed from a family with a deep musical heritage, spanning over six generations in Kashmir.
 
• Known as the **"Saint of the Santoor"** and **"King of Strings"**, his contributions to Indian classical music are monumental.
 
• He played a pivotal role in popularizing the Santoor at a global level, blending traditional and contemporary styles.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Ravan Hatta
 An ancient stringed instrument, considered a precursor to the violin, popular in Rajasthan.
 
 

 2) Tabla
 A percussion instrument consisting of a pair of drums, widely used in Indian classical music.
 
 

 3) Sitar
 A plucked string instrument used in Hindustani classical music, known for its deep and resonant sound.
